clues.text: Jacob dreamed here of a ladder reaching up to heaven, with God's angels going up and down it.
At the altar in this city, King Jeroboam stretched out his hand against a man of God, and it withered.
As Elisha walked up the road to this city, a group of boys came out and jeered at him as a baldhead.
Amaziah, the priest of this place, sent word to King Jeroboam that Amos had conspired against him.
Abram pitched his tent with this town to the west and Ai to the east, and built an altar there.
King Josiah pulled down Jeroboam's altar in this city, burned the high place, and ground it to powder.
During the war against Benjamin, all Israel went up here, wept before the LORD, and fasted until evening.

taken: Traveling from Beersheba toward Haran, he dreamed of a ladder to heaven with God's angels going up and down.
